summary.text: NAM scored 298-9 in their innings, led by Michael van Lingen with 124 off 121 balls, while Ehsan Adil took 4 for 41. USA chased the target to win by 4 wkts, reaching 286-6 thanks to Monank Patel c scoring 108 off 100 balls as Jan Nicol Loftie-Eaton claimed 2 for 39.
